basic_info.description: Enjoy comfortable top-floor living in this bright and spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath condo in Potrero Hill. Offering 1,605 sqft of well-designed space, this home features a functional layout with an upper-level primary suite complete with a fireplace, walk-in closets, and a private bath. The middle level includes two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and generous closet space. The kitchen features stone countertops, hardwood flooring, and built-in appliances for everyday ease and convenience. This west-facing home receives abundant natural light throughout the dayfrom warm morning sun to glowing afternoon light. Step onto the private deck to take in wide, scenic views of Twin Peaks, a standout feature that adds to the homes charm. Set in a quiet two-unit building, this home provides more privacy than larger complexes. Low HOA fees are a bonus. Conveniently located less than a mile from Jackson Playground Park and just a short drive to Mission Bay Kids Park, Bernal Heights Park, and Costco. Enjoy easy access to public transportation, restaurants, and shopping. With its ideal location, sunlight-filled interiors, and impressive views, this top-floor condo is a great opportunity to own a comfortable and stylish home in one of San Franciscos most desirable neighborhoods.
